title: Temporal Adaptive Fine-Tuning for Code Comprehension

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种名为“时序自适应微调”（TAFT）的方法，以解决代码库演化带来的对齐偏差问题。 Repository-level code comprehension question answering (QA) supports developer reasoning over functionality and usage distributed across codebases. However, repository-specialized large language models (LLMs) can become misaligned as code evolves. We study this challenge as temporal repository adaptation: acquiring new knowledge, suppressing obsolete, retaining still-valid, and preserving semantically neighboring knowledge. Existing retrieval, fine-tuning, and model-editing methods address only parts of this problem. We propose Temporal Adaptive Fine-Tuning (TAFT), a novel adaptation approach that treats repository transitions as supervision. TAFT derives temporally grounded QA data from repository transitions, pairs newly valid with obsolete knowledge through preference optimization, and replays transition-conditioned retention examples to preserve still-valid knowledge. We evaluate TAFT on an augmented temporal SWE-bench dataset comprising 255,295 QA entries across ten temporal slices, comparing deferred (Baseline), per-slice retrained (Baseline-Batched), and variants with knowledge anchors along four dimensions: updated knowledge, obsolete-answer suppression, retention, and neighbor stability. TAFT consistently outperforms both the deferred and batched baselines, with an average relative improvement of 18% in updated/suppressed knowledge accuracy, doubled retention accuracy, and roughly 1.5 times the neighbor accuracy. With directly supplied knowledge anchors, TAFT-KANT further improves mean updated/suppressed, retention, and neighbor accuracy over TAFT by 3.55%, 8.35%, and 13.00%, respectively. Overall, TAFT demonstrates its effectiveness across all evaluated areas, effectively enabling code comprehension QA alignment with repository evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种名为“时序自适应微调”（TAFT）的方法，以解决代码库演化带来的对齐偏差问题。仓库级代码理解问答（QA）支持开发者对分布在代码库中的功能和使用方式进行推理。 然而，随着代码的演化，专门针对仓库的大型语言模型（LLM）可能会出现对齐偏差。 我们将这一挑战视为时序仓库适应问题：获取新知识、抑制过时知识、保留仍然有效的知识，并维持语义上相邻的知识。 现有的检索、微调和模型编辑方法仅解决了该问题的一部分。 我们提出了时序自适应微调（TAFT），一种将仓库变化视为监督信号的创新适应方法。 TAFT从仓库变化中生成具有时序依据的问答数据，通过偏好优化将新有效的知识与过时知识配对，并重复播放受变化条件约束的保留示例，以维持仍然有效的知识。 我们在一个增强后的时序SWE-bench数据集上评估了TAFT，该数据集包含十个时序切片中的255,295条问答条目，并将延迟训练（Baseline）、按切片重新训练的模型（Baseline-Batched）以及沿四个维度（更新知识、抑制过时答案、知识保留和相邻稳定性）加入知识锚点的变体进行了比较。 TAFT在性能上始终优于延迟训练和批量训练的基线模型：在更新/抑制知识的准确性方面平均相对提升18%，知识保留准确性提升一倍，相邻知识准确性约为1.5倍。 当直接提供知识锚点时，TAFT-KANT在更新/抑制、保留和相邻知识准确性方面的平均值分别比TAFT提升了3.55%、8.35%和13.00%。 总体而言，TAFT在所有评估领域均展现出有效性，能够有效地使代码理解问答与仓库演化保持对齐。
